name: squashfs-tools
description: Offline SquashFS extraction for explicitly selected native release artifacts

storage.rationale: Extraction output belongs to the invoking artifact owner; the system tool has no project-owned persistent storage.

installHint: Explicit optional setup only: scenario-dependency-analyzer deps install system/squashfs-tools --scenario squashfs-tools --surface host-tool --apply. The release is parsed offline; its AppImage executable is never run for extraction.

macos.evidence: Native OpenRGB macOS releases use ZIP extraction through the standard library.

windows.evidence: Native OpenRGB Windows releases use ZIP extraction through the standard library.
